summary: FASE 1 Dynamic Theme System - Full E2E test passed. Login (admin/admin123 -> role-admin -> login-submit) works, Cabina di Regia loads, 'Aspetto & Tema' tab (cabina-tab-theme) opens section-theme panel. Changing theme-color_gold and theme-radius updates CSS vars (--sh-gold, --sh-radius) on documentElement in real time (live preview). Preset 'Notte' correctly updates input values. Save (theme-save) calls PUT /api/admin/settings -> 200 and shows toast 'Tema salvato e applicato'. After reload of public Home (/), CSS variable --sh-gold reflects the saved value (#2f8f6b) and GET /api/content/settings returns the updated theme. After reset-and-save, theme restored to defaults (--sh-gold=#BE9E5E, radius=20) and HOME reflects it. End-to-end persistence verified.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeSection applies live preview via useEffect([t]) which mutates documentElement CSS vars globally. If the user navigates away without saving, the stale preview may persist until next ThemeInjector refetch invalidation. Consider cleanup on unmount to reset to persisted theme.
DEFAULT_THEME is duplicated between frontend (ThemeInjector.jsx) and backend (seed_extra.py). Keep in sync carefully; consider a single source if API grows.
Native <input type='color'> uses browser default picker, not a shadcn component - acceptable UX but noted.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (role: admin) - login via /accedi -> choose-login -> role-admin -> fill login-username/login-password -> login-submit
seed_data_creation: None. Theme restored to defaults after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /accedi flow requires THREE steps: data-testid='choose-login', then data-testid='role-admin', then fill login-username + login-password + click login-submit. Theme state is persisted on MongoDB settings doc (field 'theme') and exposed via GET /api/content/settings; writes via PUT /api/admin/settings do $set non-distructive merge. CSS vars live on document.documentElement.style (--sh-gold, --sh-gold-strong, --sh-ink, --sh-bg, --sh-surface, --sh-text, --sh-emerald, --sh-amber, --sh-radius, --sh-font-display, --sh-font-body).
